name: Off-Site Discoverability Audit

identity_anchoring: outbound links to known identity providers
corroboration_surface: press / newsroom / awards / coverage surface in readable text
quotability: pages carrying a figure, price, date or quantity
contact_reachability: email or phone number present as readable text

thresholds.answer_engine_schema: >=5 of the 6 types absent AND an Organization block already exists
thresholds.quotability: fewer than half of crawled pages carry a concrete fact
thresholds.identity_anchoring: no sameAs target and no outbound identity-provider link

emits_no_findings_because: A defect must cite a reproducible measurement (lib/contracts.make_finding rejects anything else). From one origin this skill can observe that a site publishes no anchor; it cannot observe whether the wider web corroborates it. Asserting 'this brand is uncorroborated' would report something never measured.
non_defects: valid Organization JSON-LD with no sameAs (site-010 is healthy)
an About page with no numbers on it
absent structured data entirely - that is content-semantics-audit's finding, not a second report of one root cause

safety.network: none - consumes the shared snapshot, fetches nothing of its own
